request_scope: Coordinate field across explicitly requested supported collections; not an all-sky mirror or mission-completeness claim
limitations: SIA2 ingestion may lag browsable directories, the archive GUI and some TAP results; zero rows do not establish mission-wide absence.
TAP samples at most one authoritative DataLink association list per nonempty collection within the shared request budget; unqueried or failed associations remain unknown.
Pipeline versions, calibration associations and pixel quality remain unknown where the metadata service does not supply them.
A complete requested query scope is not a complete all-sky archive index.
interpretation: Metadata only. No image acquisition, detection or temporal comparison is established.
